target: Read-only pre-promotion audit of the Hong Kong VPS origin and SSO boundary for the Site32 v1.13 candidate; active predecessor is Site32 v1.12

checks.evidence: UFW reported active with low logging, default deny incoming, allow outgoing and routed traffic disabled. The only inbound allowances were SSH, HTTP and HTTPS for IPv4 and IPv6.

Socket inventory confirmed both the authentication origin and command-center application origin were loopback-only. Neither application origin was wildcard-bound; public web exposure remained behind Caddy.

Boolean-only Caddyfile inspection confirmed local forward authentication, propagation of X-User and X-Role, and reverse proxy to the local command-center service. Caddy configuration validation passed and xrd-auth, xrd-cmdcenter and Caddy were active.
A public HTTPS request to /api/public_status carrying forged X-User and administrator X-Role headers returned HTTP 401.
xrd-auth ran under its dedicated account with ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=tmpfs, PrivateTmp=yes, PrivateDevices=yes and NoNewPrivileges=yes.
xrd-cmdcenter ran under its dedicated account with ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=tmpfs, PrivateTmp=yes, PrivateDevices=yes and NoNewPrivileges=yes.
The active Site32 v1.12 predecessor manifest verified successfully before candidate upload and matched digest c77d1a2ccbcc1ec7a30a4d39a0c36276a1bcbda22e89be1a55e37f5cb7b03b7d.
No credential, token, private key or secret value was read or recorded during this audit.

observations: The active predecessor at audit time was site32-global-commercial-v1.12-20260720 and its manifest verified successfully.
The origin boundary rejected forged identity headers before application access.
Cloudflare dashboard or API evidence for managed WAF, bot controls and edge rate limiting was not available in this audit.
No Wi-Fi, VPN, proxy, route, ARP, SSH configuration, firewall rule, DNS, Cloudflare setting, Caddy configuration or SSO configuration was changed.
No X5, Pi, robot, arm or instrument endpoint was contacted.
claim_boundary: Point-in-time operator evidence only; not a penetration test, Cloudflare WAF certification, commercial security certification or proof that every VPS process is vulnerability-free.
